title: Performance of Private Corporate Business Sector during Q4:2025-26
description: Today, the Reserve Bank released the data on performance of the private corporate business sector during the fourth quarter of 2025-26, drawn from abridged quarterly financial results of 3,266 listed non-government non-financial companies1. This summary position also includes comparable data for Q3:2025-26 and Q4:2024-25 to enable study of sequential (q-o-q) and annual (y-o-y) change (web-link: https://data.rbi.org.in/DBIE/#/dbie/reports/Statistics/Corporate%20Sector/Listed%20Non-Government%20No
